author: TeIq
content: Delivered: Leptos 0.8 CSR-only frontend with leptos_router + leptos_meta. Top-level App component with Dashboard route firing PolarisApiClient::healthz on mount. PublicAtprotoClient trait + target-separated native (reqwest-backed proto_blue_xrpc) + wasm (gloo-net-backed proto_blue_xrpc) impls. PolarisApiClient trait + native (reqwest) + wasm (gloo-net) impls. Cookie credentials wired so the session cookie flows. FrontendError thiserror enum at error.rs. Trunk.toml + index.html for wasm bundling. .github/workflows/ci.yml with fmt + clippy + test + wasm-build jobs — AC-12 institutionalized. No tokio in frontend. No leptos_axum. No serde_json::Value in wire types. Target conditionals concentrated at module boundaries, not sprinkled in business logic.
